title: CSCI 621 — Foundations of Database System Implementation
subject: Data Management
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a relational model, including tables, keys, and constraints, and explain how they enforce data integrity.
Explain how indexing and hashing structures provide efficient access paths for query processing and optimize database performance.
Describe the role of transaction management and concurrency control in maintaining atomicity, isolation, and durability in database systems.
